titleVi: Y khoa, Bệnh học & Trị liệu Chuyên sâu
themeSummaryVi: Làm chủ từ vựng y khoa C2: phân biệt malignant vs benign, chronic vs acute, prognosis vs diagnosis, Three of a Kind và bài đọc Coming to Terms with Cancer.

schemaItems.definitionEn: Virulent, infectious, or uncontrollably invasive, especially of a tumor that metastasizes.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Ác tính, có khả năng xâm lấn và di căn hủy hoại cơ thể.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: The biopsy confirmed that the excised throat lesion was indeed malignant and required urgent intervention.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: A dark jagged cell mass rupturing its cellular membrane and aggressively spreading tendrils outward.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: Not harmful in effect; mild and non-cancerous in pathological condition.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: A smooth luminous sphere self-contained peacefully within a soft translucent bubble.

schemaItems.definitionEn: Persisting for a long time or constantly recurring over years.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Mãn tính, dai dẳng kéo dài nhiều năm tháng khó dứt điểm.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: I suffered occasionally for twenty years, but it has only recently transformed into a chronic complaint.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: A continuous low-frequency crimson hum oscillating relentlessly along an infinite timeline.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: Experienced to an intense, sharp degree over a short duration.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: A blinding instantaneous bolt of lightning discharging violently at a single focal point.

schemaItems.definitionEn: The clinical forecast of the likely future course and outcome of a disease.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Tiên lượng bệnh; dự đoán khoa học về tiến triển hồi phục trong tương lai.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: The oncologist delivered an encouraging prognosis: early detection afforded a 90% full remission rate.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: A forward-looking telescope beaming a focused vector of light through a misty pathway.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: The identification of the nature of an illness by examination of current symptoms.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: A high-magnification microscope laser analyzing a static specimen pinpoint under glass.

schemaItems.definitionEn: Tending to weaken or enfeeble someone to a severe, incapacitating degree.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Làm suy nhược kiệt quệ, bào mòn thể lực và tước đoạt sức sống.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: Rheumatoid arthritis can prove utterly debilitating if aggressive therapy is not initiated swiftly.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: A glowing kinetic armature buckling downward under an invisible gravitational load.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: Making one feel fresh, energized, and brimming with vitality.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: A geyser of effervescent electric cyan sparks shooting effortlessly upward.

schemaItems.definitionEn: To gradually recover health and strength over time after illness or medical surgery.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Tĩnh dưỡng phục hồi sức khỏe, lại sức dần sau bạo bệnh.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: The patient was transferred to a tranquil coastal sanatorium to convalesce after bypass surgery.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: Faint emerald embers slowly gathering warmth, brightening steadily into a resilient flame.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: To deteriorate or fall back into illness after a period of temporary improvement.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: A budding flower abruptly drooping and shriveling back into shadowy cold soil.

schemaItems.definitionEn: To make a disease, pain, or acute problem significantly worse and more severe.
schemaItems.definitionVi: Làm trầm trọng thêm căn bệnh, làm bùng phát cơn đau dữ dội hơn.
schemaItems.exampleSentence: Administering the wrong compound only served to exacerbate the patients pulmonary inflammation.
schemaItems.visualMetaphor: Pouring volatile accelerant onto a smoldering fire, triggering explosive fiery plumes.
schemaItems.contrastDefinitionEn: To make suffering, deficiency, or pain more bearable and less severe.
schemaItems.contrastVisualMetaphor: A cool crystal droplet descending and soothing a scorched ember into gentle steam.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: A cancerous, invasive mass of tissue that metastasizes to other organs.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Khối u ác tính (ung thư có nguy cơ lây lan).
collocationPairs.example: Biopsy analysis revealed the presence of a malignant tumour in the lymph nodes.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: A scientifically controlled study testing modern therapies on human volunteers.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Thử nghiệm lâm sàng thuốc mới trên người.
collocationPairs.example: The groundbreaking immunotherapy drug is undergoing Phase III clinical trials.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: The physiological reproductive window of human fertility as age advances.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Đồng hồ sinh học sinh sản.
collocationPairs.example: At 34, she felt the pressure of her ticking biological clock as she deliberated pregnancy.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: A specialized clinical follow-up examination conducted after surgical incisions.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Buổi tái khám hậu phẫu với bác sĩ phẫu thuật.
collocationPairs.example: The surgeon confirmed clean wound margins during the post-operative consultation.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: A medically induced state of total unconsciousness and analgesia for major surgery.
collocationPairs.example: She was placed under general anaesthetic and remained asleep throughout the two-hour surgery.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: A medical condition or anatomical defect present at birth.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Dị tật bẩm sinh / rối loạn bẩm sinh có từ trong bụng mẹ.
collocationPairs.example: Echocardiograms revealed a congenital disorder in the infant's ventricular valve.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: A sudden, abrupt loss of mechanical heart function and blood circulation.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Cơn ngừng tim đột ngột đe dọa tính mạng.
collocationPairs.example: Defibrillator pads were applied within seconds of the patient suffering cardiac arrest.

collocationPairs.meaningEn: An incurable illness that will ultimately cause death within an estimated time.
collocationPairs.meaningVi: Căn bệnh nan y giai đoạn cuối không thể cứu chữa.
collocationPairs.example: Palliative hospice care focuses on dignified comfort for patients with a terminal illness.

domainSortItems.clueEn: An examination of tissue removed from a living body to discover the presence of disease.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Máy khử rung tim khẩn cấp
domainSortItems.clueEn: An apparatus used to control heart fibrillation by application of an electric current.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Chăm sóc giảm nhẹ cho bệnh nhân nan y
domainSortItems.clueEn: Specialized medical care focusing on relief from pain and stress of serious illness.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Mầm bệnh, vi sinh vật gây bệnh
domainSortItems.clueEn: A bacterium, virus, or other microorganism that can cause systemic disease.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Giả dược dùng trong thử nghiệm lâm sàng
domainSortItems.clueEn: A harmless pill or dummy treatment given in clinical trials as a control.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Di căn tế bào ung thư
domainSortItems.clueEn: The spread of cancer cells from primary site to secondary areas of the body.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Dao mổ phẫu thuật lưỡi siêu bén
domainSortItems.clueEn: A small, extremely sharp bladed instrument used for delicate surgery and dissection.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Thuốc ức chế miễn dịch chống thải ghép
domainSortItems.clueEn: An agent that prevents or diminishes the body's immune response to a transplanted organ.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Sự thuyên giảm bệnh (không còn tế bào ung thư)
domainSortItems.clueEn: A temporary or permanent diminution of the severity of disease or cancer symptoms.

domainSortItems.meaningVi: Thuốc gây mê / gây tê phẫu thuật
domainSortItems.clueEn: A substance that induces insensitivity to pain with or without loss of consciousness.

triLockPuzzles.rootHint: Physical anatomy / Foreign entity / Regulatory assembly
triLockPuzzles.meaningVi: Dị vật xâm nhập (foreign body) / Nhiệt độ cơ thể (body temperature) / Hội đồng chuyên gia
sentences: The neurosurgeons extracted a metallic foreign ___ lodged near his cranium.
His core ___ temperature had fallen dangerously low into severe hypothermia.
An independent professional ___ was convened to review clinical ethics.
nuanceNotes: Emergency surgery: extraneous object inside physical tissue.

triLockPuzzles.rootHint: Physical suffering / Pain threshold / Analgesic relief
triLockPuzzles.meaningVi: Ngưỡng chịu đau (pain threshold) / Cơn đau nhức đầu / Thuốc giảm đau (pain relief)
sentences: The pediatric patient possessed a notoriously low ___ threshold, requiring local numbing.
He complained of a throbbing, unbearable ___ in his chest before collapsing.
The pharmacist dispensed two packets of effervescent ___ relief caplets.

triLockPuzzles.rootHint: Dermal surface / Epidermal graft / Outer covering
triLockPuzzles.meaningVi: Ung thư da (skin cancer) / Ghép da (skin graft) / Phát ban nổi mẩn da
sentences: Dermatologists diagnosed an aggressive malignant melanoma of the ___.
The third-degree burn on his forearm required an emergency autologous ___ graft.
Her entire upper torso came out in a blistering red ___ rash from the antibiotic.

triLockPuzzles.rootHint: Release from hospital / Fluid drainage / Firing an electric charge
triLockPuzzles.meaningVi: Xuất viện về nhà / Chảy dịch mủ vết thương / Phóng xung điện
sentences: The attending physician signed the formal orders to ___ the patient from the ward.
Nurses noted an abnormal yellowish ___ oozing from the surgical incision site.
The defibrillator capacitors delivered an instantaneous electrical ___ across the sternum.
nuanceNotes: Hospital administration: official authorization to leave care.

triLockPuzzles.rootHint: Intravenous line / Falling liquid droplet / Continuous sound
triLockPuzzles.meaningVi: Truyền dịch tĩnh mạch (on a drip) / Nhỏ giọt chậm / Tiếng nước rỉ
sentences: Post-surgery, the patient was hooked up to an intravenous saline ___ for 48 hours.
The steady hypnotic ___ of water from the leaking tap kept the whole ward awake.
The anesthetic infusion was calibrated to ___ slowly into the venous cannula.

morphologicalFamilies.transformationPrompt: After four rounds of targeted immunotherapy, the lymphoma is officially in complete ___ (remiss).
morphologicalFamilies.explanationVi: In remission là cụm y khoa chỉ bệnh ung thư đã thuyên giảm và không còn dấu vết.

morphologicalFamilies.transformationPrompt: Blood chemistry assays confirmed a severe iron ___ (deficient), prompting intravenous infusions.
morphologicalFamilies.explanationVi: Iron deficiency là tình trạng thiếu sắt / thiếu máu trong huyết học.

morphologicalFamilies.meaningVi: Mang tính di truyền gia đình
morphologicalFamilies.transformationPrompt: Genetic counseling revealed that the predisposition to ovarian tumors was purely ___ (heredity).
morphologicalFamilies.explanationVi: Hereditary bệnh di truyền truyền từ thế hệ này sang thế hệ sau.

morphologicalFamilies.transformationPrompt: The oncologists final ___ (prognose) was exceptionally optimistic owing to early stage intervention.
morphologicalFamilies.explanationVi: Prognosis là tiên lượng kết quả điều trị bệnh tật.

personaCards.meaningEn: Aggressive, metastatic, and relentlessly destructive to biological host cells.
personaCards.meaningVi: Khối u ác tính hủy hoại tế bào lành.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Invasive Spore breaches cellular margins and attempts systemic metastasis!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Malignant (ác tính, xâm lấn hung hãn) đối nghịch trực diện với benign (lành tính, vô hại).

personaCards.meaningEn: Enduring relentlessly across decades; permanent and stubbornly recurring.
personaCards.meaningVi: Căn bệnh mãn tính dai dẳng quanh năm.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: Brief, sudden, sharp, and resolving rapidly.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Eternal Torment drains stamina steadily with unrelenting systemic inflammation!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Chronic (mãn tính, âm ỉ trường kỳ) đối lập với acute (cấp tính, bộc phát dữ dội trong thời gian ngắn).

personaCards.meaningEn: A person abnormally anxious and obsessively convinced they have severe illnesses.
personaCards.meaningVi: Kẻ tưởng tượng ra bệnh, lúc nào cũng lo lắng thái quá về sức khỏe.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: A person who endures genuine pain with complete composure without panic.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Phantom Sufferer diagnoses themselves with rare tropical diseases after a sneeze!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Kẻ hoang tưởng lo sợ bệnh tật (hypochondriac) đối lập với người khắc kỷ kiên cường (stoic).

personaCards.meaningEn: Draining all muscular vigor and rendering the victim utterly incapacitated.
personaCards.meaningVi: Gây suy nhược bại liệt tàn phế.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: Imparting robust vitality, rejuvenation, and boundless energy.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Atrophy Ray saps kinetic vigor from all active joints!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Debilitating (làm hao mòn suy kiệt) bị hóa giải bởi invigorating (tiếp thêm sinh lực sung mãn).

personaCards.meaningEn: Signaling an irreversible, fatal outcome that medicine cannot halt.
personaCards.meaningVi: Giai đoạn cuối không thể cứu vãn.
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: Amenable to complete medical eradication and full restoration of life.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Final Horizon signals that conventional interventions have reached their boundary!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Terminal (vô phương cứu chữa, giai đoạn cận tử) đối lập với curable (hoàn toàn có thể chữa khỏi).

personaCards.meaningEn: A hypothetical remedy claiming to cure all diseases and solve every malady.
personaCards.meaningVi: Phương thuốc vạn năng trị bách bệnh (thần dược huyền thoại).
personaCards.oppositeMeaningEn: A poisonous substance producing systemic harm and organ failure.
personaCards.battleScenario: The Mythic Elixir purges all afflictions and balances the biological field!
personaCards.counterExplanationVi: Panacea (thần dược trị bách bệnh) đối lập với chất độc hủy hoại tạng phủ (toxin).

binaryPrecisionPairs.contextSentence: The patient presented with sudden, ___ abdominal spasms requiring emergency appendectomy within the hour.
binaryPrecisionPairs.distinctionVi: Acute là cấp tính (bộc phát dữ dội đột ngột); Chronic là mãn tính (kéo dài âm ỉ nhiều năm).

binaryPrecisionPairs.contextSentence: While the initial ___ identified pulmonary tuberculosis, the long-term ___ for recovery remained superb.
binaryPrecisionPairs.distinctionVi: Diagnosis là chẩn đoán tìm ra tên bệnh hiện tại; Prognosis là tiên lượng kết quả tương lai sau điều trị.

binaryPrecisionPairs.contextSentence: The pathologist had reassuring news: the excised polyp was completely ___, presenting zero risk of metastasis.
binaryPrecisionPairs.distinctionVi: Benign là u lành tính không lây lan; Malignant là u ác tính ung thư.

binaryPrecisionPairs.contextSentence: The heart murmur was not acquired through infection; rather, it was a ___ defect present from birth.
binaryPrecisionPairs.distinctionVi: Congenital là bẩm sinh có từ khi chào đời; Contagious là truyền nhiễm lây từ người sang người.

binaryPrecisionPairs.contextSentence: You are at the wrong reception desk: this corridor is for overnight ___s staying for continuous monitoring.
binaryPrecisionPairs.distinctionVi: Inpatient là bệnh nhân nội trú nằm viện qua đêm; Outpatient là bệnh nhân ngoại trú khám xong về trong ngày.

binaryPrecisionPairs.contextSentence: Her elderly grandmother suffered from senile ___, gradually losing reasoning abilities and personal memories.
binaryPrecisionPairs.distinctionVi: Dementia là chứng sa sút trí tuệ tuổi già làm suy thoái thần kinh; Amnesia là chứng mất trí nhớ tạm thời sau chấn thương.

narrativeChronicle.title: Coming to Terms with Cancer
narrativeChronicle.subtitleVi: Đối Diện Với Ung Thư — Bản Lĩnh & Hy Vọng Trong Nghịch Cảnh
narrativeChronicle.settingDescription: The surgical oncology consultation room. Fluorescent lights buzz softly as a 33-year-old patient receives life-altering biopsy results.

segments.promptTextBefore: The prognosis was not good. I may not have had a terminal illness, but the doctor revealed that I had a(n)
segments.promptTextAfter: tumour that had already begun spreading to my lymph nodes.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: The realization hits like a physical blow: aggressive treatment must commence immediately.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Malignant tumour là khối u ác tính di căn.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: A benign tumour does not spread to lymph nodes or require emergency cancer oncology!
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Benign là u lành tính, hoàn toàn mâu thuẫn với việc di căn hạch bạch huyết.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Convalescent refers to a recovering person, not a cellular cancer growth.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Convalescent là người đang dưỡng bệnh, không thể dùng làm tính từ cho khối u.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Calling a spreading cancer 'nominal' makes your oncologist drop their clipboard in disbelief.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Nominal là không đáng kể trên danh nghĩa, vô cùng nguy hiểm khi nói về ung thư!

segments.promptTextBefore: The excision could not wait. I would have to be put under general
segments.promptTextAfter: again and would be completely unconscious for roughly two hours.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: The counting backwards from ten begins; monitors hum steadily as surgery gets underway.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: General anaesthetic là thuốc gây mê toàn thân cho phẫu thuật lớn.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Giving someone a placebo before cutting open their throat means they feel every scalpel incision!
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Placebo là giả dược không hoạt tính, phẫu thuật dùng placebo là tra tấn dã man!

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Antibiotics kill bacteria; they do not knock you unconscious for two hours during throat surgery.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Antibiotic là thuốc kháng sinh, không có tác dụng gây mê phẫu thuật.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: You cannot put a patient under 'general remission' like a blanket.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Remission là trạng thái thuyên giảm bệnh, không phải chất gây mê.

segments.promptTextBefore: Chemotherapy was ruled out because of family complications. I opted instead for preventive
segments.promptTextAfter: surgery to excise the adjacent tissue before any further mutation occurred.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: The surgical margins are cleared cleanly, eliminating the risk of recurrent mutation.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Elective surgery là phẫu thuật chủ động lựa chọn phòng ngừa trước khi quá muộn.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Surgery cannot be contagious; cancer surgery is not a cold that catches on people.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Contagious là truyền nhiễm lây lan, không dùng để phân loại loại hình phẫu thuật.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Calling preventive cancer surgery 'hypochondriac surgery' mocks a genuinely life-saving operation.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Hypochondriac là chứng lo sợ bệnh hoang tưởng, hoàn toàn không tương thích.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Morbid describes morbid obesity or gloomy fascinations with death, not a medical procedure type.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Morbid mang nghĩa bệnh lý hoặc bệnh hoạn, không đi với phẫu thuật chủ động.

segments.promptTextBefore: At 33, my situation is complicated by the fact that my partner and I were planning a family. My biological
segments.promptTextAfter: is ticking, but for today, the cancer is in complete remission.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Tears of relief fall as the final scans show zero evidence of disease; the future is open once more.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Biological clock is ticking là collocation C2 nổi tiếng về đồng hồ sinh học sinh sản.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: A 'biological alarm' makes it sound like your pancreas rings loudly at 7:00 AM.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Biological clock là thành ngữ cố định; biological alarm không tồn tại trong tiếng Anh tự nhiên.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Calling the human fertility window a 'biological trial' sounds like a university lab exam.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Biological trial không mang ý nghĩa độ tuổi sinh sản của người phụ nữ.

choices.whatIfFeedbackEn: Your biological pulse does not 'tick' about having babies; hearts beat, clocks tick.
choices.nuanceExplanationVi: Collocation chuẩn xác với ticking là clock (đồng hồ sinh học).
